E4Plus1.uk.title: Made in Chelsea
E4Plus1.uk.description: Brand new series: Sam Prince and Maali's secret kissing continues, but at Maali's dinner party, their cover is blown... And Philip's commitment to Georgia is in doubt yet again. (S32 Ep4)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares USA
E4Plus1.uk.description: Peter's: Gordon visits Peter's Italian Restaurant in New York, where the peace of Long Island is shattered by the antics of the volatile Pellegrino family who run the place. (S1 Ep1)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares USA
E4Plus1.uk.description: The Mixing Bowl: Bijou New York diner The Mixing Bowl is haemorrhaging money thanks to manager Mike's out-of-control marketing plans. Can Gordon get things back on track? (S1 Ep2)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares USA
E4Plus1.uk.description: Seascape: Gordon Ramsay visits the Seascape restaurant in the seaside village of Islip, on Long Island in New York, where owner Peter has nearly a million dollars of debt. (S1 Ep3)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares USA
E4Plus1.uk.description: The Secret Garden: Gordon Ramsay visits a romantic French restaurant in California, where temperamental chef Michel Bardavid's complicated cuisine is keeping the customers away. (S1 Ep5)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: How the Test Was Won: When Bart gets top marks in a test, Lisa's so shocked that she freezes in her exam. Homer desperately avoids danger after failing to renew his insurance. (S20 Ep11/21)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: No Loan Again, Naturally: When Homer and Marge's mortgage rate skyrockets, they have to put their house up for sale - and Flanders buys it and becomes their landlord. (S20 Ep12/21)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: Gone Maggie Gone: When Marge temporarily loses her sight, Homer loses Maggie to a convent and Lisa has to go undercover as a nun to find her. (S20 Ep13/21)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: In the Name of the Grandfather: Homer takes the family to Ireland so that Grampa can visit quaint village pub O'Flanagan's one last time. (S20 Ep14/21)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: Wedding for Disaster: Homer and Marge discover that they're not officially married when Reverend Lovejoy finds out he wasn't a licensed minister at the time of their ceremony. (S20 Ep15/21)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: Them, Robot: Mr Burns replaces the power plant's staff with robots but decides to keep Homer as the only human employee. (S23 Ep17/22)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: A Totally Fun Thing Bart Will Never Do Again: Bart sees an ad for the ultimate cruise, begs his parents for a holiday, and then tries to make the vacation last forever. (S23 Ep19/22)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: The Spy Who Learned Me: While he's on sick leave, Homer learns how to be a better husband, with the help of dashing spy movie crime fighter Stradivarius Cain (Bryan Cranston). (S23 Ep20/22)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: Springfield Splendor: Lisa and Marge team up on a graphic novel that becomes a musical. But Marge takes all the credit... (S29 Ep2/21)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: Whistler's Father: Maggie reveals a hidden talent, which Grampa tries to exploit. Marge gets a job as a decorator for the mob. (S29 Ep3/21)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Uncharted
E4Plus1.uk.description: (2022) Going-for-gold action. Tom Holland and Mark Wahlberg compare abs as they scour the globe for an olde explorer's lost gold. The heat is on. The time is right. Only the best survive.

E4Plus1.uk.title: Celebrity Gogglebox
E4Plus1.uk.description: The celebrities watch 127 Hours, Planet Earth II, Cape Fear, This Morning on public toilets, EastEnders, Bradley Walsh & Son: Breaking Dad, and BBC News on beaches. (S2 Ep5)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Gogglebox

E4Plus1.uk.title: Gogglebox
E4Plus1.uk.description: On the 'Box this time: Sweetpea, Michael McIntyre's The Wheel, Will You Marry Me?, Deal or No Deal, I Love a Mama's Boy, National Parks from Above, This Morning and ITV News. (S24 Ep8) [SL]

E4Plus1.uk.title: First Dates
E4Plus1.uk.description: Series one favourite Rajan returns to the restaurant, hoping to be fourth time lucky. Will his chat-up lines impress Corinne, who has a history of meeting the wrong men? (S2 Ep3/8) [SL]

E4Plus1.uk.title: First Dates
E4Plus1.uk.description: Can metrosexual Jon find headstrong Mancunian Regan's soft side? Playboy Mostafa believes every girl would like to marry him. And heavy-metal fan Dan returns to the restaurant. (S2 Ep4/8) [SL]

E4Plus1.uk.title: Vanderpump Rules
E4Plus1.uk.description: Back Alley Betrayal: Audrey performs a roast comedy routine. And it goes down like a lead balloon with one member of the group in particular... (S12 Ep11)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Vanderpump Rules
E4Plus1.uk.description: Pride and Joy: Audrey's stand-up routine has left Angelica reeling. So how better to deal with it than a confrontation? Chris plots a grand romantic gesture. (S12 Ep12)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares USA
E4Plus1.uk.description: Hot Potato Café: The Hot Potato Café in Philadelphia has never made a profit. When the chips are down, can Gordon help save the restaurant? (S3 Ep1) [SL]

E4Plus1.uk.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares USA
E4Plus1.uk.description: Flamangos: Gordon visits Flamangos in rural New Jersey, where mother and daughter Adele and Cheryl are stuck in their tropical ways. But their restaurant is far from paradise. (S3 Ep2) [SL]

E4Plus1.uk.title: Hollyoaks Omnibus
E4Plus1.uk.description: James fears that he's being framed. Frankie jumps into action when Leah is found unconscious. Dodger has concerns about Gemma's involvement in Ste's disappearance. And a chase ensues...

E4Plus1.uk.title: Rude(ish) Tube Shorts
E4Plus1.uk.description: A short, cheeky clip featuring animals and food, from the always hilarious Tube that is Rude.

E4Plus1.uk.title: Modern Family

E4Plus1.uk.title: Modern Family

E4Plus1.uk.title: Modern Family
E4Plus1.uk.description: Under Pressure: The high school open house puts the parents in a time warp when Claire gets stressed out by all the pressure. Jay teaches Phil how to play truant. (S5 Ep12)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares USA

E4Plus1.uk.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares USA
E4Plus1.uk.description: Giuseppi's: Gordon Ramsay visits a family-owned Italian in Michigan, run by a father and son who constantly clash. Can he get the restaurant - and the family - back on track? (S2 Ep1)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares USA
E4Plus1.uk.description: Handlebar: Gordon Ramsay takes on a time warp at the Handlebar restaurant and lounge in Mount Sinai, New York, where the owners are stuck in the 80s with an unenthusiastic chef. (S2 Ep6)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares USA
E4Plus1.uk.description: Brand new series - Lyla's Family Restaurant (Part 1/2): Owner Waleed's American dream has turned into a full-blown Nightmare, but he's still firmly in denial... (S10 Ep7)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Great British Bake Off
E4Plus1.uk.description: In a Bake Off first, it's Audience Choice Week! The bakers face a mystery box and unleash their inner fashionistas with wearable bakes. Whose faux pas sees them saying au revoir? (S17 Ep3) [SL]

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: Grampy Can Ya Hear Me: Grampa's new hearing aid tells him more about the world than he wants to know. Skinner learns that his mother shattered his boyhood dream. (S29 Ep5/21)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: Haw-Haw Land: Nelson goes all-out to impress Lisa when she falls for the talented new boy at school. And Bart takes up chemistry - but to what end? (S29 Ep10/21)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: Homer Is Where the Art Isn't: Homer learns to love a Miro painting. Then it's stolen - and he gets the blame. (S29 Ep12/21)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: Eeny Teeny Maya Moe: Homer takes Maggie to Moe's and accidentally leaves her in the playground outside the bar. Meanwhile, Moe's delighted to get to know a woman online. (S20 Ep16/21)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons

E4Plus1.uk.title: New: Lego Masters Australia

E4Plus1.uk.title: Free Guy
E4Plus1.uk.description: (2021) Comedy action starring Ryan Reynolds. Guy lives in Free City. Free City isn't real. Nor is Guy. It's all a big online game. Can he take down the corrupt game publisher?

E4Plus1.uk.title: Gogglebox
E4Plus1.uk.description: This time on the Box: Heartstopper, Made in Chelsea, The Circle, Bee Czar, Ramsay's Future Food Stars, and BBC News covering Keir Starmer's lockdown 'Beergate' controversy. (S19 Ep13)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Inbetweeners
E4Plus1.uk.description: Work Experience: Jay arranges work experience for himself and Simon at his dad's company, but a mix-up leaves Neil at a newspaper and Will at a garage. (S2 Ep2/6)
